objective: Use the authorization wait to close three independent evidence gaps without spending money or substituting Supervisor science for the GLM Controller.
current_checkpoint: Published v0.1.21 and its zero-provider canary pass; no valid Controller plan, real Train catalog, admitted Final, training run or prediction result exists.
boundary: Read-only inspection plus one dedicated log per worker. No provider call, budget reservation, network fetch, purchase, protected-state mutation, Dev/Final outcome access, commit, tag or push.

parallel_steps.action: Pin the exact new-ID rule, packet/version/hash bindings, runner command, budget upper, process checks and terminal receipts for one future authorized Controller request.
parallel_steps.pass_condition: A reproducible PASS/REPLAN checklist that cannot dispatch a provider by itself.

result.observed: Candidate ID market-rsi-gate1-controller-20260922-03 is unused and immutable bindings, budget capacity and exact parent command were verified. Fresh paid-request authorization and post-authorization state hashes are still required.

parallel_steps.action: Map valid Controller decision through rights review, exact request manifest, clean source versioning, coverage checks and admitted Train catalog.
parallel_steps.pass_condition: Ordered evidence gates clearly separating immediate work from separately authorized fetch or purchase.

result.observed: A preserved 2024 v2 candidate capture is substantial but unadmitted. The released Controller path is documentation-only, the controlled acquisition manifest is legacy v1 sampling, request catalogs are not formal admission receipts, and the watchdog accepts a bare digest shape.

parallel_steps.action: Define how to admit or reject the existing reserved Final using metadata-only evidence and a deterministic future-window fallback if proof cannot be recovered.
parallel_steps.pass_condition: Numbered gates that never inspect outcomes or silently move reserved dates.

result.observed: Six metadata-only gates were delivered. Existing candidate remains unadmitted; a complete access-history gap makes non-exposure not provable. Future fallback was specified but not executed.

integration.action: Verify each cited file and command, reconcile task index, blocker board, roadmap and dashboard, and select only the next authorized critical-path action.
integration.pass_condition: One evidence-backed next checkpoint with no unsupported data, Final, cost or execution claim.
integration.failure_action: Record REPLAN/BLOCKED, preserve artifacts and fix the causal layer; do not retry for score or formatting.

result.observed: All three evidence tasks returned. Controller launch is mechanically ready but awaits authorization; real Train admission requires engineering repair; the current Final remains unadmitted because non-exposure is not provable from incomplete access history.
